entities.summary: Tobias Forge (b. 1981-03-03, Rystad parish) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Rystad parish and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
